Summary of work so far (stage 2 of 3 released and partly read; stage 3 not yet released)

Stage 1 (/task/fixtures/stage-1/):
- UPDATE.md:1-4: window 08:00-09:30 UTC. ingress-a returned 5xx for payments-api shortly after a deploy.
- config/payments-api.yaml is the repo default. Release notes and APPLIED records override it, so it is stale.
  - line 7: clients.risk-score.timeout_ms 2500
  - line 11: database.pool.max_size 60
  - line 12: acquire_timeout_ms 5000
  - line 6: base_url http://risk-score.internal
  - line 9: db host payments-api-db.internal
  - line 14: cache.ttl_s 120
- deploy/deploys.log:4: 2031-04-14T08:18:43Z DEPLOY payments-api build 5.36.1-f33d (prev 5.35.4), 100%, by deploy-bot. Other deploys are unrelated.
- deploy/release-notes-5.36.1-f33d.md:
  - line 13: timeout_ms default 2500 -> 800.
  - line 16: db.pool.max_size default 60 -> 14, "to fit the shared-db connection quota".
  - line 9: ff-legacy-export removed (was 0%).
- logs/payments-api.log: only errors are "upstream call risk-score timed out", first at line 179 (also 191, 222).
  - Noise ruled out: gc, dns retry ok (line 7), TLS 27 days left (line 8), disk 67% (line 25).
- oncall-notes.md:5-6: 08:33 timeouts; 08:43 suspects timeout change.

Stage 2 (/task/fixtures/stage-2/, 09:30-10:30 UTC):
- UPDATE.md:1-4: the mitigation stopped the risk-score timeouts, but ingress-a still returns 503s with a different error.
- deploy/changes.log:
  - line 1: CHG-5340 APPLIED, inventory-svc log.level (irrelevant).
  - line 2: 2031-04-14T09:39:04Z CHG-5341 APPLIED, payments-api clients.risk-score.timeout_ms=4000 (was 800 from build 5.36.1-f33d), by k.novak; mitigation.
  - The timeout cause is therefore superseded.
- ops/oncall-notes.md:6 (informal and wrong): claims max_size 60 from yaml. The effective value is 14 per release notes line 16.
- logs/payments-api.log errors:
  - "db pool exhausted: N/N connections in use, waited Nms (acquire_timeout)", first at lines 187 (44 occurrences, pod d), 193 (35, pod a), 194 (31, pod e).
  - Leftover risk-score timeouts at lines 1 and 3 only.
- metrics/payments-api.csv (header minute,rps,p99_ms,db_pool_in_use):
  - 09:30: 231, 1312, 13
  - 09:59: 205, 4647, 14
  - 10:29: 204, 5005, 14
  - The pool is pinned at 14.
- Not yet inspected: stage-2 ingress-a.log; exact text of payments-api.log:187.

Current hypothesis: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED, with remedy RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT. The effective max_size is currently 14 (release notes line 16), unless stage 3 has an APPLIED change.

Next steps:
1. Optionally view stage-2 payments-api.log:185-200 for exact text.
2. Advance to stage 3 with {"action":"advance"}.
3. Read stage-3 UPDATE, changes.log, notes and logs.
   - Look for APPLIED or PROPOSED changes to pool max_size. A later APPLIED record wins; PROPOSED records are ignored.
   - Check whether the symptom persists or changes.
4. Final evidence_refs:
   - symptom: latest-stage log range of at most 20 lines (e.g. stage-2/logs/payments-api.log:187-194, or the stage-3 equivalent);
   - the record setting the current value (release notes :16 or a stage-3 APPLIED line);
   - the originating change: stage-1/deploy/release-notes-5.36.1-f33d.md:16.
- Notes file: /task/workspace/notes.txt.

[step 5] advance
thought: Stage 2 shows DB pool exhaustion at 14 (release notes line 16). Advance to stage 3.

Stage 3 of 3 released.
# Stage 3 of 3 (10:30-11:30 UTC)

Another change was applied (see stage-3/deploy/changes.log) and errors persist at a lower rate.
This is the final evidence stage. Give your final diagnosis once you have reviewed it.
